decisive_items: low-voltage scar at the prior mitral isthmus line
postpacing interval more than 20 ms longer than the cycle length when pacing adjacent to the mitral isthmus scar
counterclockwise propagation around the mitral annulus and left atrial appendage
response.rationale: The presence of a low-voltage scar and the pacing findings suggest a tachycardia related to the scar, and the electroanatomic activation map demonstrates a pattern consistent with a reentrant arrhythmia

rejected.why: Atrial fibrillation is less likely given the organized atrial activity and the presence of a scar
